row.evidence: Fullstory's SCIM article says "Requires an Enterprise plan" and SAML SSO is ticked only for Enterprise in the pricing comparison; all paid plans are "Request pricing & demo".
row.notes: Unchanged status: SCIM and SAML SSO are Enterprise-only and need SAML configured first. Business, Advanced and Enterprise are all quote-based (session-based); FullstoryFree gives 30,000 sessions/month. June's third-party price estimates (~$10-25K/yr Business, ~$80K+/yr Enterprise) are dropped (no first-party source). SCIM is officially supported only with Okta, through a custom SAML app (the published OIN app does not support SCIM); other IdPs "should work in principle". Deprovisioning disables the user (no SCIM delete) and frees the seat; SCIM Groups need Fine-Grained Access Controls. Roles via the fullstory:2.0:User role extension. The Server API Users endpoints manage captured end-user identities, not Fullstory seats; no seat-management API found.

auth.token_source: Settings > Account Management > SSO > Account Provisioning: SCIM Provisioning > Generate Authorization Token (Admin)

deprovision.data_retained: User is disabled, not deleted; objects they created remain and are accessible again if re-enabled.

custom.how: role attribute in urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:fullstory:2.0:User (admin, architect, standard, explorer, guest)

roles.how: Okta group attribute "role" in the fullstory:2.0:User extension maps groups to Fullstory roles; umbrella manager not supported.

limitations.text: Only Okta is officially supported, and only via a custom SAML app; the published Okta app does not support SCIM. Other IdPs should work "in principle".
SCIM cannot delete users; deprovisioning always disables.
SCIM Groups need Fine-Grained Access Controls (Enterprise) and an active SCIM user connection; groups deleted in the IdP are permanently deleted in Fullstory.
Okta cannot use the same group for app assignment and Group Push.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit Trails API covers settings history (blocking, privacy, capture settings), not user or login events.

limitations.text: The Server API "Users" resource manages identified end users of the customer's site (uid from FS.identify), not Fullstory account members.

user_api.notes: No API for Fullstory seats (invite, role, disable) found in the developer sitemap or help centre.

okta.notes: OIN app (rendered) checks SAML only; Fullstory documents SCIM through a custom SAML app with SCIM enabled.

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial covers SAML SSO with JIT; Fullstory says SCIM is only supported with Okta.

fallbacks.notes: csv_import here is the bulk-upload invite tool (up to 30 users at once).
